name: Ammunition (Firearms): Thunderball
body:
A thunderball is a dwarven invention. This single musket ball can be loaded as normal into any pistol or musket. On a successful hit with the thunderball round, the shot explodes and does an additional 2d6 points of fire damage to the target.
